title: Update log
text: This list. Every change to the site gets a line here, newest first. A dot on the Updates button means there's something you haven't seen.

title: Nightly backups
text: The site's data is copied every night, so nothing is lost if something goes wrong.

title: Reply to the teacher
text: When the teacher sends a ticket back with a note, write a reply before you send it for check-off. The TV shows a red "Reply to teacher" tag on that ticket until someone replies.

title: Ticket numbers start at #38
text: The 37 repairs done on paper count toward Devices repaired, and new tickets continue the numbering at #38.

title: Your own login
text: Sign in with your school email and the password your teacher gave you. Forgot it? Ask your teacher to reset it.

title: Edit your notes
text: Work sessions can't be deleted any more. Press Edit note on your own session to fix what you wrote. Sessions can overlap, and none can go past 2:15 PM.

title: TV password from the site
text: Admin Panel → TV Password changes the classroom TV's password. The TV then needs to be signed in again.

title: Picked Up and shelf spots
text: Finished repairs show as Ready for Pickup until the teacher marks them Picked Up. Write where a device is kept (shelf or bin) on its ticket.

title: Customer Slip
text: Print a Customer Slip after New Ticket. Its QR code opens the customer's repair tracker.

title: Logging time
text: Log today's work during class. Start and end times fill in for you.

title: Teacher on tickets
text: New Ticket has a box for the customer's teacher. It shows on the ticket and the invoice.

title: Invoice
text: Each ticket has an Invoice section: add the tasks and parts, then print it under Paperwork. It replaced the Hours sheets.
